# TrendingDays Tools Hub

> https://trendingdays.com/

A premium, 100% private library of high-precision, client-side web utilities and calculators. All tools process data locally in-browser with zero server logging or database footprint.

## Core Calculators

- [Age Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/age-calculator/): Precision age tracking in years, months, weeks, and days.
- [BMI Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/bmi-calculator/): Instantly computes Body Mass Index and healthy weight ranges.
- [Loan & EMI Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/loan-calculator/): Computes monthly financial loan repayments and interest breakdowns.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/percentage-calculator/): Solves percentage variations, increases, and decreases.
- [Secure Password Generator](https://trendingdays.com/password-generator/): Generates randomized crypto-secure keys completely offline.
- [Universal Unit Converter](https://trendingdays.com/unit-converter/): Converts metric and imperial benchmarks seamlessly.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://trendingdays.com/word-counter/): Real-time analysis of text structural lengths.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/sales-tax-calculator/): Computes retail tax overheads and net costs.
- [Discount Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/discount-calculator/): Tracks markdown clearances and final retail values.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/date-calculator/): Counts exact durations between calendar points.
- [Speed & Pace Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/speed-calculator/): Analyzes velocity data and athletic running splits.
- [Margin & Markup Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/margin-calculator/): Essential business analytics for wholesale pricing models.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/simple-interest/): Measures basic capital yield timelines over fixed rates.
- [GPA Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/gpa-calculator/): Aggregates academic grades across weighted scales.
- [Random Generator & Picker](https://trendingdays.com/random-generator/): High-integrity localized randomized lists and dice rolls.
- [Advanced Scientific Calculator](https://trendingdays.com/scientific-calculator/): Core trigonometric, algorithmic, and engineering math equations.
